title: NOAA raw time series data is irregularly spaced
body: It looks like the raw data samples hourly but also intermixes irregular samplings in between the hourly data The out of the box LSTM network is not well suited for irregularly spaced time series data so we should either remove non hourly sampled rows or retrain the models using an LSTM variant capable of handling this data such as Time LSTM https www ijcai org proceedings 2017 0504 pdf I can test out both options and see which yields better results

title: Convert HOURLYPressureTendency variable to be categorical
body: HOURLYPressureTendency is actually a categorical variable From the NOAA LCD documentation Press Tend Pressure tendency In general a 0 through 3 here indicates an increase in pressure over previous 3 hours and a 5 through 8 indicates a decrease over the previous 3 hours and 4 indicates no change during the previous 3 hours See ISD Documentation under Atmospheric Pressure Change for further details We can convert it to 9 dummy variables or bucket into 3 dummy variables using the buckets discussed above This will alter model inputs preprocessing postprocessing testing and model files

title: Compress multivariate model predictions within proper bounds
body: Currently the multivariate model which forecasts all 12 weather features does not post process the predictions to ensure they are within allowable bounds For example HOURLYVISIBILITY predictions should be within 0 10 miles but some predictions are slightly above 10 or slightly negative Similar issues arise for the following variables HOURLYVISIBILITY HOURLYRelativeHumidity HOURLYWindSpeed HOURLYWindDirection HOURLYPrecip

comments.body: I added some basic post processing a few weeks ago but there is room for improvement https github com IBM MAX Weather Forecaster pull 17 files

title: Improve API input format
body: Currently the model can only take in a numpy array of weather data in txt format with a specific hard coded shape specifically the number of data rows in the input array As a user I would like to be able to post a single data point in this case a data point would be a 12 hour timeframe of data and receive a single prediction to post data in a more user friendly format i e JSON For bulk requests we could add a bulk predict endpoint We could support CSV files rather than or in addition to numpy arrays in txt serialized format
